## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm test` on Node 22.
- [ ] I added or updated tests proportional to risk.
- [ ] I updated product, developer, and data documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] Schema changes include a reviewed migration and export-compatibility note.
- [ ] New content is original/clearly licensed and includes source metadata.
- [ ] I checked keyboard, focus, responsive, reduced-motion, and non-color behavior for UI changes.
- [ ] I included no secrets, personal learner data, production dumps, or large generated output.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance and completed human factual, license, security, and similarity review.
